test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 'Vaghya Murali' dance, associated with Lord Khandoba, originated in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vaghyaya Murali,** is a** Maharashtran folk dance** based on the story of **Khandoba**, the **reincarnation of Lord Shiva on earth.**
 
• Khandoba is a regional deity in **Maharashtra and the foremost centre of worship of Khandoba is Jejuri.**
 
• In this dance males are assumed as **Vaghyaya and females as Murali.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
